title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: From ape-men to the Star Child: a mysterious monolith drives exploration of space, and the astronaut Bowman survives the murderous computer HAL to pass beyond the infinite.

title: Hamlet
creator: William Shakespeare
summary: A prince's delayed revenge for his murdered father, poisoned by grief, moral outrage, and disgust at his mother's remarriage, ending in a court strewn with corpses.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
creator: J. K. Rowling
summary: An orphan discovers he is a wizard, finds friends and a school full of wonders, and with them solves the mystery of the Stone and faces Voldemort.

title: In Search of Lost Time
creator: Marcel Proust
summary: Memory, jealous love, and snobbery: the narrator's childhood, Swann's and his own tormented loves, the salons' status wars, grief, and the recovery of lost time through art.

title: Journey to the West
creator: Wu Cheng'en
summary: Monkey's rebellion and cultivation, then a comic pilgrimage with Tripitaka, Pigsy, and Sandy through demon-infested lands to win the scriptures and Buddhahood.

title: Little Red Riding Hood
creator: Charles Perrault
summary: A girl carrying food to her sick grandmother is tricked and eaten by a wolf; in the Grimm version a huntsman cuts them free and the wolf dies.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
creator: Agatha Christie
summary: Poirot unravels the stabbing of a child-killer on a snowbound train and finds twelve passengers united in avenging the Armstrong family.

title: One Piece
creator: Eiichiro Oda
summary: Luffy and his Straw Hat crew sail the Grand Line to become Pirate King, bound by friendship and dreams, fighting tyrants and freeing islands along the way.

title: The Iliad
creator: Homer
summary: Wrath, honor, and grief among warriors: Achilles' rage at Agamemnon, his revenge on Hector for Patroclus, and Priam's plea, inside a coalition war fought for Helen.

title: The Metamorphosis
creator: Franz Kafka
summary: Gregor Samsa wakes as a giant insect; his family's care curdles into disgust and rejection, and he starves to death while they move on.

title: The Shining
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: Snowbound in a haunted hotel, Jack Torrance descends into rage and tries to murder his wife and psychic son, who flee as he freezes in the maze.

title: The Song of Roland
creator: Anonymous
summary: Ganelon's betrayal, Roland's proud last stand at Roncevaux beside Oliver, Charlemagne's grief and vengeance on the Saracens, and the traitor's trial.

title: The Tale of Genji
creator: Murasaki Shikibu
summary: Courtly love and rank: Genji's many affairs, his lifelong bond with Murasaki, jealous rivals and spirits, and the melancholy of loss across generations.

title: Titanic
creator: James Cameron
summary: A cross-class romance between Rose and Jack aboard the doomed liner, opposed by her jealous fiance and ended by the freezing sea, remembered by Rose for a lifetime.
